title: Nice to See You
description: Ko Ideum is a complete recluse who excels at just one thing: crafting fervent BL smut. However, there’s a minor issue: Ideum is entirely inexperienced in romantic encounters. In an attempt to stimulate his mind (and other aspects), Ideum resorts to…well, “taking care of himself” in front of the window, envisioning various steamy scenarios to ignite his creativity. While there might be an apartment directly opposite his, it has been vacant for years…until now! During one of his self-love sessions, he glances up to find a man gazing at him from across the street - and not just any man, but the bisexual sensation and likely future celebrity, acting major Kwon Jaeyi. Some could argue their situation is a tad too intimate for comfort…but perhaps it’s just the perfect distance for something deeper.

title: Kiss Me If You Can
description:
*"Six months... Just six months, and it'll all be over."*  
After a one-night stand Hollywood with top star Chase Miller, Joshua finds out he’s pregnant. As a single father, Joshua raises their child in secrecy. But when he is forced to return to work as Chase’s bodyguard, the two are reunited in a cruel twist of fate. Relieved that Chase doesn’t seem to remember him, Josh’s comfort is short lived -  something primal, something desperate, yearns for the touch of his former lover, and every time he sees this beautifully twisted man, Josh’s heart races in spite of his mind. The more time passes, the more boundaries blur as instinct takes over… Will Joshua be able to resist the lips of his former lover? Or are the strings of fate too strong to resist? *(Source: Lezhin)*

title: Rolling in Bed with the Male Lead
description: Richard, the second male lead, has continuously failed to capture the heroine's affection through numerous regressions. Each time, the heroine ultimately selects the undesirable male lead, resulting in Richard—fated to be the second male lead—being left behind and solitary. Frustrated by her repeated choices of the male lead, Richard resolves, after forty-eight regressions, to attempt one last strategy: to seduce the male lead himself.

title: Jinx
description:
Physical therapist Kim Dan has been down on his luck for as long as he can remember. Between an ailing grandmother, menacing loansharks, and an old boss making it almost impossible for him to find work, Dan is truly running out of options. Naturally, it feels like a dream come true when he’s finally hired to treat top-paid MMA fighter Joo Jaekyung, especially when the man then calls him out for a treatment the night before a match with an oh-so-tantalizing offer of five thousand dollars. He claims to have a “jinx” in need of a particular type of “treatment," but it's one that Dan isn't quite prepared to offer… You see, Jaekyung may be a beast in the ring, but he’s even rougher in the bedroom, and Dan’s not sure he can survive Jaekyung at his most primal. Nevertheless, the promise of much-needed cash has Dan agreeing to this ill-fated deal... Could a night together be the thing to help Jaekyung break this jinx once and for all?

title: Blossoms of the White Night
description:
To secure an alliance between the northern kingdom of Leracal and the southern realm of Arnata, the countries’ royal families agree to a political marriage. Tei, known across the frozen battlefields as the most fearsome warrior and monster hunter, volunteers himself as the kingdom’s hostage, trading his life as a warrior for that of a bride. In Arnata, Tei finds not the hostility he anticipated but the calm, steady gaze of Shuraka, the young crown prince destined to become both his spouse and future Padisha of the empire. For Shuraka to claim the throne, however, he must survive an uprising that threatens the kingdom - once that forces him to draw the blood of his own brothers. Moved by the courage and gentle integrity of his betrothed, Tei pledges to protect him at any cost…and in the quiet hours of a white night, two hearts caught between loyalty and longing begin to bloom.

title: Accidental baby
description: Transitioning from best friends to lovers and then to parents... Jo is entirely dedicated to her career as an accountant, which seems to be the reason her long-term boyfriend chose to leave her. Overwhelmed by her grief, she seeks solace in her best friend, Liam. He has always been there for her in times of distress, but unexpectedly, neither of them can suppress their feelings, leading them to spend the night together. The following morning, as they go their separate ways, they agree to forget what happened and maintain their friendship. However, Jo soon discovers she is pregnant... and Liam is adamant that they should marry. Jo thinks it’s solely for the baby's sake, but could it signify something deeper?

title: The Sacred Serpent's Seduction
description:
How far would you be willing to go to save the ones you love? With his grandfather bordering life and death, Taesun takes on multiple jobs in order to pay a seemingly endless stack of hospital bills. On one of his odd jobs, he ascends the great mountain Geumryang, unknowingly the home of an eponymous serpentine spirit. When Taesun encounters the divine being, he too is on the brink of death, desperate for water in his slithering form. Taesun offers him a sip of water, and saves the sacred snake from certain death. Later that night, a cold-blooded body embraces Taesun and offers him an exchange: bear the ancient being’s seed, and his grandfather will live. But is all really as it seems? After all, can one ever truly trust the forked tongue of a serpent…?

title: Codename Anastasia
description: Agent Kwon Taekjoo is dispatched to Russia with two tasks. First, he must find “Anastasia,” a new weapon that could change the world forever. Second, he is to avoid Russia’s psychotic killer, Psikh Bognadov, at all costs. To assist him on his undercover mission, Taekjoo is sent a partner who only reveals himself to be a man named Zhenya. But Zhenya quickly proves himself to be just as dangerous and unhinged as the infamous Psikh himself. Just who could he truly be? And will Taekjoo succeed in tracking down “Anastasia”?

title: Desire Me if You Can
description: Grayson Miller a pour but de rencontrer son âme sœur. Un chamane lui a annoncé que son partenaire serait « quelqu'un lié au feu, avec une forte poitrine ». Plus tard, il rencontre par hasard un pompier oméga remarquable au milieu d'un incendie… et s'évanouit ! Dans le but de retrouver cette personne, Grayson rejoint la caserne de pompiers, mais finit par se battre violemment avec le pompier Dane… et se retrouve inévitablement mêlé à lui malgré tout…

title: Shutline
description:
Shin is barely making ends meet, hustling as a rogue mechanic on the mean city streets. Problem is, work never comes easy and the dough is nothing to shout about. But when Jake pulls up with car trouble one day, it’s obvious that there’s money to be made: he’s tall, blond and dressed like a million bucks. Jackpot. And after such a handsome payday, Shin is reluctant to let this sucker go. Little does he know that giving Jake his number may be the biggest mistake he’s ever made. And it isn’t long before Jake wants more than his car fixing… *(Source: Lezhin)*

title: Behind the Stage
description: Jin-woo, a hardworking model student, makes the decision to go clubbing for the very first time. Under the influence of alcohol, Jin-woo ends up having an impulsive one-night stand with the first attractive man he meets, only to find himself alone in an empty room the following morning. On the bedside table are several 50,000 won bills. Perplexed, Jin-woo presumes he has been paid for s** and is filled with anger, but chooses to push the incident to the back of his mind. After he returns to university, Jin-woo assists his juniors with their performance and locks eyes with a familiar figure on stage. It's the man from that night whom he believed he would never encounter again, Kwon Tae-young. Then, in front of everyone, Tae-young exclaims with a glint in his eye: "Found you."

title: After a Meal
description: On a wintry day filled with snow, Chang-deok discovers Jong-woo, a high school student, squatting in front of his beloved gukbap restaurant. Persuaded by Jong-woo's assurance to replicate the dish he loves, Chang-deok brings him into his home. Unable to turn down Jong-woo's offer to stay for a month in return for a tasty dinner each day, the two start a fragile living arrangement. However, it appears that Jong-woo is concealing something from Chang-deok...

title: Happy Together
description: Four years prior, the idol group Dream Boy fell apart following a scandal that ended their careers, leading them toward failure. Currently, Jaeyoung, who was known as "Happy" in Dream Boy, is struggling to support himself by delivering food. One evening, he learns that Sookyeom, the former leader of the group, is passed out drunk at a club, prompting him to rush to his aid. At the club, Jaeyoung suffers a collapse due to photosensitivity syndrome. He is rescued by Seungmin, who also carries the stage name "Happy," but unlike Jaeyoung, he has become the most sought-after rapper and producer in the industry. Seungmin then proposes, "You know who I am, right? Let's collaborate on a track together."

title: Flashlight
description:
Aaron Hunter’s got it all. Looks, talent, and he just won the award for best actor. He does have one issue though: trouble sleeping. The only thing that’ll get him to fall asleep is a certain song by a certain someone. And when they finally meet, this is Aaron’s chance to get him to write a new song. But will the mysterious singer accept this deal? And will past traumas become illuminated by their newfound relationship…? *(Source: Lezhin)*

title: Things that deserve to die
description:
Contract killer Lee Jagyeong’s gun never misses, piercing the heart with flawless precision. It does not matter how bad the target is. He takes the job, kills the mark, gets paid, and that is the end of it. The only things he believes in are his own skills and money.

Then one day, a sudden high paying request comes in from a regular client. Five million dollars, with a single condition: Kill Kang Ilhyeon and retrieve one item from his safe.

The target is the son of Korea’s crime syndicate kingpin.
Kang Ilhyeon is a man with sharp, serpentine eyes.
Standing inside a trap Ilhyeon has laid out, Jagyeong finds himself slowly being cornered, the noose tightening around his neck.

*“I heard a very interesting story while I was on a business trip to Hong Kong.”  
“……”  
“Aren’t you curious what that interesting story is?”  
“Someone’s trying to kill me. In my own house, no less.”  
“Explain it. I’ll decide whether to believe you after I hear it.”*

Will Jagyeong succeed in killing Kang Ilhyeon and completing the job, or will he meet a pointless death himself?

A battle between men who would not be surprising to see dead at any moment has begun.

title: The Boundary of Delusion
description:
Mok-yeon is approached with a proposition for a threesome by his friend and sexual partner, Sun-hwa. The third participant is Nan-jo, a man whom Sun-hwa has been pursuing. Although Nan-jo is enjoyable to be around due to his wealth and kindness, he lacks excitement in bed. Initially, Mok-yeon was merely curious about Nan-jo, but during the threesome, he found himself unable to look away from him. Mok-yeon then makes an enticing suggestion to Nan-jo, who is determined to protect Sun-hwa from him.

"I’d like to have a taste of your body, Nan-jo. Would you be willing to spread your legs for me?"

title: Perfect Error
description: Ji Sunjeong knows exactly how cruel the world can be, especially for an omega scraping by at the absolute bottom. But nothing prepares him for the night he steps into a dark alley and watches the city’s most beloved billionaire philanthropist, Beom Seongheon, brutally beat a man half to death. Disgusted by the alpha’s saintly facade, Sunjeong decides to leverage the secret in order to secure his freedom. Surprisingly, Seongheon easily plays along, opening his wallet and pulling Sunjeong into his orbit. But Seongheon isn't without his own reasons. Both believe they hold the leash in this toxic game of mutual exploitation, but as their cold-blooded transaction spirals into a breathless attraction, the line between hunter and prey begins to vanish...				+

title: Love is an Illusion! - Superstar
description:
Byul, a popular alpha and a first-year high school student, once trained to be an idol but has since left that path to attend school like a regular kid. His world takes an unexpected turn with the sudden birth of a younger sibling, introducing new challenges to his daily routine. Byul's childhood friend, Siwoo, has secretly harbored feelings for him for years. However, both being alphas, Siwoo has kept his emotions hidden.

As the two navigate their growing closeness after a period of time apart, Byul faces adolescence head-on, grappling with friendships, family relationships, and his sense of identity. Along the way, he rediscovers his passion for music and begins to mature through these transformative experiences. *(Source: Lezhin)*

title: Night by the sea
description: Having reached his limits and abandoned everything, Omega Kim Euihyun fled towards the sea while carrying a child in his arms, only to be intercepted by an alpha, Yeo Taejoo. Left with nothing but debts, Euihyun was offered money, a house, and even employment by Taejoo, provided he agreed to give his body. "But why am I so turned on? You smell so fucking good" -VV Scans (VVS)-

title: Eye of the Storm
description:
Hwan Woon-ryong and Beom Pung-ho have spent their entire lives locked in a fierce rivalry. As the heirs to the world’s two most powerful crime syndicates, their hatred runs deep—and so does their competition. But just as they’re poised to seize the biggest opportunity of their careers, fate throws them a curveball: a toddler named Hwan Beom-hae, who, according to advanced DNA testing, is the biological child of both of them.

Caught between disbelief and chaos, the two enemies are presented with an absurd yet high-stakes mission: raise Beom-hae together, lovingly and responsibly. The reward? Exclusive construction rights to the largest global development project in history, sanctioned by the United Nations itself. But co-parenting isn’t exactly easy when you’d rather strangle your partner than share snack time and diaper duty.

As Beom-hae’s giggles and tantrums slowly chip away at their walls, Woon-ryong and Pung-ho must navigate tantrums, toys, and a growing sense of responsibility—not to mention some unexpected feelings. Can two lifelong enemies become the world’s most unlikely dream team dads? Or will their stubborn pride and unresolved tension bring everything crashing down?

Enemies-to-daddies has never looked this chaotic—or this heartwarming.

title: Die In My Arms
description:
**Note: This work is tagged as "hardcore" and portrays triggering stalking themes. Viewer discretion is advised.**

A gambler. A failure. And now a divorcé after ending ten years of marriage. This is the life of Jung Cheol. With nothing going right, he barely has time to lament his misfortunes when the very person who started it all returns. Ji Minyoung, his former lover—his fear, his nightmare, and the one he loved so desperately—is back. The person who made Cheol run for most of his life stands before him again.

*“I’ll stay with you until the moment you die, Cheol.”*
